malformedEvent.classification: IllegalArgumentException on the message publication topic, including the cause chain and JSON null, is dead-lettered without retries in both gateway-service-v1 and notification-service-v1

crashWindow.method: child JVM hard kill after the Gateway SQL append and before inbox completion, plus unit-test fault injection

previousSnapshots.note: Before T216 the retries counter counted every failed-delivery callback, including the exhausted attempt; 6 callbacks correspond to 4 retries under the current definition.

measurementLimits: Local Docker PostgreSQL Testcontainers and Redpanda run; not production traffic or an SLO measurement.
Hard process termination is covered by hardKilledConsumerReplaysFromKafkaUsingTheSameDurableDatabase; broker process stop/restart is not.
Retry and dead-letter counts include both gateway-service-v1 and notification-service-v1 groups.
processed and end-to-end samples are per consumer attempt; two concurrent deliveries of one event can both be counted.
The shared recoverer writes exhausted records from every listener, including authorization projection listeners, to the message dead-letter topic; filter by the topic field.
